'''Repairing''' in Matcha Flavoured has no limit: the "Too Expensive!" cap is removed, and any tool or armor can be repaired forever in an [[anvil]].

== Mechanics ==
* Whenever an item with a repair cost enters the inventory, its repair cost is reset to 0.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/endless_repairs/function/reset_breakable_repair_cost.mcfunction}}</ref> This part is based on MiziraGamez's Repair Cost Remover.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/endless_repairs/README.txt}}</ref>
* The pack removes all experience from players every tick. After a player uses an anvil, they are given 100 levels, which are removed again about 31 seconds after their inventory last changed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/anvil_xp/remove_xp.mcfunction}}</ref> Repairs therefore cost nothing in practice.
* Repairing by combining two items in the crafting grid is disabled.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>

Alloy items show a "Repaired with" line in their tooltip.

== Design ==
"Actually, I should I should also mention I've removed the XP and repairing cap. All tools can be repaired forever."{{Cite video|quote=I've removed the XP and repairing cap. All tools can be repaired forever.}} Electrum and adamant need blocks of diamond so that players do not always wear them.{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha|quote=I chose to make Electrum/Adamant only repairable with diamond blocks. The hope being, that players will not choose to ALWAYS wear these}}
